title: Poincaré Beta Balls: Radial Laws, Hyperbolic Shell Metric Transforms, and Critical-Limit Regimes
summary: On a high-dimensional Poincaré ball, a Euclidean beta-type radial measure concentrates near a sphere, but hyperbolic distance amplifies the surviving radial spread, so the usual shell reduction loses part of the limiting metric. In each regime of the balance between this radial width and amplified angular separation, we determine the weak pyramid limit of the spaces rescaled at the order at which the transition between concentration and dissipation occurs.
